description: Interactive color selection component with drag-based hue/saturation picker, EyeDropper API support, and multi-format output (HEX, RGB, HSL, CSS). Built on react-colorful and the Color library, presented inside a Popover trigger.
useCases: Theme color customization in survey branding settings
Custom color selection for chart series and data visualization
Background and accent color pickers in report builders
Design token override panels in white-label configuration
